results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding the requested splash, layout, background, shadow and typography changes, the glass has changed from visibly transparent rim/base and slender rounded sides to an opaque-looking, more tapered cup with a flat silver band; this is one clear object alteration. Instruction: The edit adds a central splash, upper uppercase sans-serif headline and bottom shadow. The expected clean white minimalist poster is only partially achieved: the background is visibly textured, the shadow is dark, the headline is dark rather than light silver-gray, and its second line is garbled instead of CLEAN TO THE END. Quality: Structure and surface rendering are generally coherent, but the visibly malformed headline and solid, sculptural-looking milk stream/splash are two noticeable flaws; the cup and ground shadow remain readable.

Consistency: Excluding the pyramid replacement, the broad horizon and foreground arrangement remain recognizable, but both the formerly smooth blue sky and sandy ground are noticeably altered by mottled color/noisy texture and changed tonality. Instruction: The smooth-sided pyramid becomes tiered with broad central stairways. A Maya stepped pyramid is partly represented, but the retained pointed pyramidal summit instead of a summit temple leaves the intended architectural transformation incomplete. Knowledge: The explanation specifies Kukulkan at Chichen Itza; the terraces and stairways support that expectation, but the pointed cap and absent rectangular summit temple clearly conflict with that structure. Quality: The building is readable with coherent main stairs and lighting, but pervasive colored speckling on the sky/ground and irregular, distorted terrace details are noticeable artifacts.
